title: Positioning Statement
one_line: Write a positioning statement that names the real alternative and survives contact with a sales call.
description: Write a positioning statement that names the real alternative and survives contact with a sales call. Use when messaging is vague, when a new product needs positioning, or when nobody can explain what the company does in one sentence.
paragraph: Positioning fails when the alternative is unnamed, because a claim to be better is meaningless without a stated comparison, and the honest alternative is usually not a competitor but doing nothing or doing it manually. This skill forces the alternative into the statement and tests the result against the objection it invites.
